name: a test widget
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

a test widget

phase_0.boundary_condition: the rendered widget frame that holds stem, options, controls, feedback and score until the attempt closes
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: rendering of stem plus options into clickable rows
AFWD.justification: moves the display from empty container toward an answerable presentation

AREV.chosen_element: reset control that clears selection and restores unanswered display
AREV.justification: draws the interface backward from graded feedback toward the prior open question

CLINK.chosen_element: chaining of select then enable submit then grade
CLINK.justification: links discrete interface actions into one ordered chain from click to evaluation

ENGAGR.chosen_element: multi answer response with right and wrong boxes ticked together
ENGAGR.justification: holds correct and incorrect marks together in one live response without discarding either

EVALF.chosen_element: incorrect choice marked with correction styling
EVALF.justification: marks the state where the selected option misses the answer key and triggers hint text

EVALT.chosen_element: correct choice marked with confirmation styling
EVALT.justification: affirms the state where the selected option matches the answer key

FFUSE.chosen_element: feedback merger that combines arm outcomes into one panel
FFUSE.justification: rejoins correct and incorrect evaluations into a single displayed result with updated score

FSPLIT.chosen_element: grading fork that opens one path per answer class
FSPLIT.justification: splits the submitted response into a correct selection arm and an incorrect selection arm

IFIX.chosen_element: append only attempt log with timestamp and score delta
IFIX.justification: writes a permanent record of each submission that cannot be edited from the interface

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: widget self identifier matching its test item id
IMSCRIB.justification: states that this rendered item is itself and no other question in the item set

TANCH.chosen_element: sealed result view with locked score and disabled controls
TANCH.justification: contains all clicks and grades inside a finished frame that accepts no further input

VINIT.justification: no stem text, option rows or score exist yet, only an unfilled container awaiting widget code

phase_2.fuse_element: feedback merger that combines arm outcomes into one panel
phase_2.fuse_result: unified feedback panel showing marks, explanation and updated score counter
phase_2.rejoin_note: correct arm applies confirmation styling and score increment while incorrect arm applies correction styling and hint text, then both rejoin in the feedback merger. The kernel computes the outcome over SIXTEEN_3.
phase_2.split_element: grading fork that opens one path per answer class
phase_2.split_input: submitted answer payload with selected option ids
split_outputs: correct match arm with confirmation and score increment
incorrect match arm with correction and hint text
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) - both held at once: multi answer response contains correct and incorrect ticks together
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) - constructively refuted: selection misses the answer key and correction shows
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) - constructively proven: selection matches the answer key and confirmation shows
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) - neither: unanswered widget with no selection graded and no score set

steps.domain_action: empty mount point awaits widget code
widget binds to its assigned item id
question stem and options render as clickable rows
submission opens correct arm and incorrect arm
score counter increments for correct match
hint text points back to the stem for review
multi select response holds correct and incorrect ticks together
arms rejoin into unified feedback panel with score
attempt with timestamp writes to append only log
feedback links forward to retry or next question
widget locks into sealed result view

phase_5.alfs_store: item bank and answer key store that supplies stems, options and correct mappings
phase_5.compiler_frontend: item renderer that turns question JSON into DOM nodes, styles and event handlers
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: DOM events and callback props passed between option rows, submit control and feedback panel
phase_5.memory_mechanism: local component state for current selection plus attempt log for prior submissions
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: user click order gated by enabled states for select, submit, reset and next

phase_6.cycle_cost: one render plus one grading pass and one log write per submission
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 - render and reset balance so the cycle returns to a stable frame with only the log appended
phase_6.post_cycle_state: graded feedback with updated score and filled log entry
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: unanswered stem with zeroed score delta and empty log entry
